marta_cs: Starting onboarding for 'CobaltWave' 100-day focus: search relevancy (embeddings) + SSO. Need to align stakeholders, success metrics, and a 30/60/90 plan. @ben_cs can you lead enablement?

ben_cs: Yep. Ill run a 60-min enablement + 30-min follow-up. Need sample docs, schema, and their expected queries. Also want to capture 3 example user journeys.

ashwin_se: Tech checklist: staging workspace, API test keys, SAML metadata, and sample traffic profile. Which infra (Hosted/Dedicated) are they starting on?

leo_platform: Theyre on Hosted trial. I'll create a staging workspace and short-lived dev keys. Will also add a canary model policy.

ben_cs: Draft success criteria: (A) top-5 search p50 <250ms, (B) embedding eval ROC-AUC >0.78 on our baseline, (C) product signoff on UX by D30. Any objections?

marta_cs: Looks good. Add adoption signal: weekly active users >200 in first 90 days as a commercial trigger. Also logging for query types.

ashwin_se: Putting validation curl for staging: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```

calendar-bot: Invite created: "CobaltWave Enablement (60m)" 2025-06-11 10:00 PST. <https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/XYZ123>

leo_platform: Staging workspace ETA: tomorrow noon. Will upload a 2k-doc sample dataset.

marta_cs: Owners: ben = enablement, ashwin = infra validation, leo = staging/rollout. I'll assemble a 30/60/90 with checkpoints and risk register (SSO timing, data quality, renewal horizon ~10 months). Please flag blockers by EOD Friday.
